checks.title: Affiliate bam 'Request Payment' -> Ops nhan thong bao Slack vao kenh affiliate; khong co badge dem tren admin panel
checks.precondition: Co quyen truy cap kenh Slack 'affiliate' dung ket noi voi he thong.
steps: Affiliate bam 'Request Payment' thanh cong (tao Invoice pending).
Kiem tra kenh Slack 'affiliate' ngay sau do.
Kiem tra man hinh admin panel (danh sach invoice) xem co badge/so dem pending nao khong.
checks.observation_point: Noi dung thong bao Slack va su hien dien (hoac vang mat) cua badge/so dem tren admin panel.
checks.expected_result: Co 1 thong bao Slack moi xuat hien trong kenh affiliate ngay sau khi affiliate bam Request Payment; admin panel KHONG co badge/so dem 'pending invoices' nao.

checks.title: Admin tim duoc invoice can xu ly bang filter status=pending hoac tim theo ten affiliate tu Slack
checks.precondition: Co >=1 Invoice dang pending trong he thong.
steps: Mo man hinh Invoice tren admin panel.
Loc theo status = pending.
Doi chieu ten affiliate trong ket qua loc voi noi dung thong bao Slack.
checks.observation_point: Ket qua loc tren man hinh Invoice.
checks.expected_result: Danh sach loc hien dung cac Invoice dang pending; admin tim duoc dung Invoice can xu ly tuong ung voi ten affiliate tu Slack.

checks.title: Chuyen Invoice sang completed tu dong AJAX dien san (snapshot) payment_method_name/fee/payment_info HIEN TAI cua affiliate
checks.precondition: Invoice dang pending hoac approved, affiliate co payment_method_name/payment_info/fee hien tai da biet.
steps: Mo form Invoice, chon status = completed.
Quan sat cac o payment_method_name/fee/payment_info tren form NGAY SAU khi chon completed (truoc khi luu).
checks.observation_point: Gia tri cac o payment_method_name/fee/payment_info tren form ngay sau khi chon completed.
checks.expected_result: Cac o duoc tu dong dien (qua AJAX) dung voi payment_method_name/fee/payment_info HIEN TAI cua affiliate tai thoi diem do.

checks.title: payment_method_name/payment_info rong tren Invoice tu dong fallback ve thong tin HIEN TAI cua User
checks.precondition: Invoice co payment_method_name/payment_info rong (vd Invoice cu truoc khi co snapshot).
steps: Mo 1 Invoice co payment_method_name/payment_info rong.
Quan sat gia tri hien thi cho admin.
checks.observation_point: Gia tri payment_method_name/payment_info hien thi cho Invoice do.
checks.expected_result: Hien thi fallback dung thong tin thanh toan HIEN TAI cua User (qua getActualPaymentMethodAttribute()/getActualPaymentInfoAttribute()), khong de trong.

open_question_draft.proposed_question: Oracle cua check 'CHK-004' dang dua tren KB item KB-005, co confirmation_source.derivation='code_artifact' (phat bieu suy tu doc hanh vi code hien tai, khong phai mot yeu cau tuong minh). Theo phanh derivation (Gate C5), day khong du de la oracle STRONG. Co nguon spec_doc/po_dev_confirm hoac test_case PASS nao xac nhan day la hanh vi DUNG (khong chi la 'code hien dang lam vay') khong?
open_question_draft.reason: KB-005 vua duoc qa-knowledge-normalizer sua confirmation_source.derivation tu 'prose' sang 'code_artifact' (claim nguon normativity=IMPLIED_BY_CODE_ARTIFACT). Theo Gate C5 'phanh derivation', check chi duoc oracle_strength STRONG khi MOI oracle.kb_ids deu CONFIRMED_EXPECTED va derivation='prose'. Ha xuong BASELINE + NEEDS_CONFIRMATION cho toi khi co xac nhan tu nguon manh hon.

checks.title: Luu Invoice voi status completed -> he thong tu gui email 'Payment completed' (InvoiceCompleted)
checks.precondition: Invoice dang duoc chuyen sang completed, affiliate co email hop le.
steps: Luu Invoice voi status = completed.
Kiem tra hop thu/log email cua affiliate.
checks.observation_point: Email nhan duoc boi affiliate sau khi admin luu Invoice completed.
checks.expected_result: Affiliate nhan duoc email 'Payment completed' (event InvoiceCompleted) ngay sau khi admin luu.

checks.title: Code khong ep buoc thu tu chuyen trang thai: pending->approved->completed HOAC pending->completed truc tiep deu duoc
checks.precondition: Co 2 Invoice dang pending, dung de thu 2 duong di khac nhau.
steps: Invoice A: chuyen pending -> approved -> completed.
Invoice B: chuyen pending -> completed truc tiep (bo qua approved).
Xac nhan ca 2 Invoice deu luu thanh cong o trang thai completed.
checks.observation_point: Ket qua luu cua ca 2 duong chuyen trang thai.
checks.expected_result: Ca 2 Invoice A va B deu chuyen thanh cong sang completed; code khong tu choi duong di nao, khong ep buoc phai qua approved truoc.

checks.title: Invoice.status chi nhan dung 1 trong 4 gia tri enum
checks.precondition: Co quyen truy cap DB/API de thu set gia tri status tuy y.
steps: Thu set Invoice.status bang mot gia tri KHONG thuoc enum (vd 'rejected').
Quan sat ket qua.
checks.observation_point: Ket qua cua request/operation set gia tri status khong hop le.
checks.expected_result: He thong chi chap nhan 1 trong 4 gia tri: pending/approved/cancel/completed; gia tri khac bi tu choi.

open_question_draft.summary: Oracle STRONG cua check 'CHK-007' hien trace toi kb_id (KB-009) co confirmation_source.derivation=code_artifact (suy ra tu doc code/schema, khong phai phat bieu nghiep vu tuong minh).
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Theo luat 'phanh derivation' cua C5, STRONG chi hop le khi MOI oracle kb_id deu CONFIRMED_EXPECTED va derivation=prose. Ha xuong BASELINE cho toi khi PO/Dev xac nhan hanh vi nay dung la chu y thiet ke, khong phai tac dung phu cua viec doc code.

checks.title: Invoice.fee nullable, fallback ve PaymentMethod.transfer_fee neu trong
checks.precondition: Invoice co fee = null; PaymentMethod tuong ung co transfer_fee = $2.
steps: Tao/mo 1 Invoice co fee = null, payment method co transfer_fee = $2.
Doc gia tri getActualFeeAttribute() (hoac field tuong duong hien thi).
checks.observation_point: Gia tri fee thuc te duoc su dung cho tinh toan/hien thi.
checks.expected_result: Fee thuc te su dung = $2 (fallback tu PaymentMethod.transfer_fee), khong phai $0 hay loi.

open_question_draft.summary: Oracle STRONG cua check 'CHK-008' hien trace toi kb_id (KB-010) co confirmation_source.derivation=code_artifact (suy ra tu doc code/schema, khong phai phat bieu nghiep vu tuong minh).
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Theo luat 'phanh derivation' cua C5, STRONG chi hop le khi MOI oracle kb_id deu CONFIRMED_EXPECTED va derivation=prose. Ha xuong BASELINE cho toi khi PO/Dev xac nhan hanh vi nay dung la chu y thiet ke, khong phai tac dung phu cua viec doc code.

checks.title: So tien thuc nhan = amount - actual_fee
steps: Mo Invoice co amount=$120, actual_fee=$2.
Doc gia tri getActualReceivedAttribute() (hoac field hien thi 'so tien thuc nhan').
checks.observation_point: Gia tri so tien thuc nhan hien thi/tra ve.

open_question_draft.summary: KB-011 hien la knowledge_kind=INFERRED, confidence=LOW, confirmation_source=null (vi du so lieu minh hoa $120-$2=$118 chi la vi du, khong duoc dung lam nguon xac nhan; phan con lai cua tai lieu chi mo ta code hien tai, khong phai phat bieu nghiep vu tuong minh, nen khong du dieu kien CONFIRMED_EXPECTED). Cong thuc 'so tien thuc nhan = amount - actual_fee' (getActualReceivedAttribute()) hien CHI duoc suy ra tu viec doc code, khong con nguon xac nhan nao. De nghi PO/Dev xac nhan: cong thuc nay co dung la quy tac nghiep vu chu dich (va vi du so lieu $120-$2=$118 co dung) hay chi la suy dien tu code chua kiem chung?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Khong co confirmation_source nao cho KB-011 (knowledge_kind=INFERRED khong mang confirmation_source theo dinh nghia), nen oracle_strength phai la NONE (khac BASELINE - BASELINE con can it nhat mot OBSERVED_CURRENT lam basis quan sat; o day khong co ca quan sat lan xac nhan, chi co suy dien tu code voi confidence=LOW). Neu khong xac nhan, CHK-009 khong co can cu nao de phan biet pass/fail ngoai gia dinh tu code.

checks.title: 'approved' la trang thai trung gian xac nhan 'da duyet, sap chi' - khong tu kich hoat thanh toan
checks.precondition: Invoice dang pending, sap chuyen sang approved.
steps: Chuyen Invoice sang approved.
Quan sat co bat ky hanh dong thanh toan tu dong (goi API/gui tien) nao duoc kich hoat khong.
checks.observation_point: Hanh vi he thong ngay sau khi Invoice chuyen sang approved.
checks.expected_result: Khong co hanh dong thanh toan tu dong nao xay ra; approved chi la trang thai trung gian de Ops tu xac nhan 'da duyet, sap chi', khong tu kich hoat chi tra.

checks.title: Snapshot tren Invoice da completed khong doi khi affiliate doi payment method sau do
checks.precondition: Invoice da chuyen sang completed voi snapshot payment method A.
steps: Xac nhan Invoice da completed voi payment_method_name/fee/payment_info = snapshot cua method A.
Doi payment_method_id cua affiliate sang method B.
Mo lai Invoice da completed, doc lai cac o snapshot.
checks.observation_point: Gia tri payment_method_name/fee/payment_info tren Invoice da completed, sau khi affiliate doi method.
checks.expected_result: Invoice van giu nguyen snapshot cua method A (lich su invoice khong doi), du affiliate da doi sang method B.

checks.title: [KNOWN DEFECT C2 - khong phai expected result] Doi status sang completed KHONG goi API thanh toan nao va KHONG chan thao tac nham
checks.precondition: Invoice dang pending, Ops CHUA thuc su chuyen tien thuc ben ngoai (khong PayPal/ngan hang thuc).
steps: Mo form Invoice dang pending.
Chuyen status truc tiep sang completed MA KHONG thuc hien bat ky hanh dong chuyen tien thuc nao ben ngoai he thong.
Luu Invoice va quan sat ket qua (co bi chan khong, co canh bao nao khong).
Kiem tra email gui cho affiliate sau khi luu.
checks.observation_point: Ket qua luu form, co/khong co bat ky request goi toi API PayPal/ngan hang nao (qua network trace), va email gui cho affiliate.
checks.expected_result: He thong CHAP NHAN BINH THUONG viec doi status sang completed du chua thuc su chuyen tien; KHONG co request nao goi toi PayPal Payouts API/Stripe/API ngan hang nao; KHONG co canh bao/chan nao o tang code; affiliate VAN nhan duoc email 'Payment completed' du chua nhan tien thuc. DAY LA HANH VI HIEN TAI CUA HE THONG (known defect C2), KHONG PHAI ky vong dung - rui ro nam hoan toan o quy trinh con nguoi (Ops phai tu dam bao da chuyen tien THAT truoc khi doi status). Neu lan chay sau phat hien he thong BAT DAU chan/canh bao thao tac nay, do la 1 THAY DOI hanh vi can duoc xac nhan lai voi PO/dev truoc khi coi la fix hay regression moi.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Co co che maker-checker (2 nguoi duyet) cho buoc approved/completed hay 1 admin tu lam het tu dau den cuoi
checks.precondition: Co >=1 tai khoan admin voi quyen xu ly Invoice.
steps: Dang nhap bang 1 admin duy nhat.
Thu thuc hien toan bo quy trinh: phat hien, doi sang approved, doi sang completed - tat ca boi CUNG 1 admin.
Quan sat he thong co yeu cau 1 admin khac xac nhan them buoc nao khong.
checks.observation_point: He thong co chan/yeu cau admin thu 2 xac nhan o bat ky buoc nao khong.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - tai lieu chi mo ta 'approved' la buoc trung gian 'neu quy trinh noi bo yeu cau', tuc quy uoc van hanh, khong phai hang rao he thong; chua xac nhan co maker-checker thuc su hay khong.

open_question_draft.summary: He thong co enforce maker-checker (2 nguoi duyet) cho buoc chuyen sang approved/completed hay 1 admin co the tu lam toan bo quy trinh?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Day la kiem soat tai chinh truc tiep lien quan den known defect C2 (khong co gi chan thao tac nham); thieu maker-checker lam tang muc do nghiem trong cua rui ro loi con nguoi.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Co audit trail ghi lai ai doi status Invoice sang completed va luc nao khong
checks.precondition: Co >=1 Invoice da duoc 1 admin cu the doi sang completed.
steps: Mot admin cu the doi status 1 Invoice sang completed.
Tim kiem trong admin panel/DB mot log/audit trail ghi lai ai da thuc hien thay doi nay va luc nao.
checks.observation_point: Su ton tai (hoac vang mat) cua audit trail cho hanh dong doi status.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - tai lieu khong neu ro co log/audit trail nao hay khong.

open_question_draft.summary: He thong co log/audit trail ghi lai viec admin doi status Invoice sang completed (ai doi, luc nao) khong?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Known defect C2 noi rui ro nam hoan toan o quy trinh con nguoi va khong co gi o tang code chan thao tac nham; neu cung khong co audit trail thi khong co cach truy nguoc khi xay ra sai sot/mat tien.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] Admin co sua tay duoc cac o snapshot (payment_method_name/fee/payment_info) truoc khi luu khong
checks.precondition: Invoice dang chuyen sang completed, cac o snapshot da duoc AJAX dien san (CHK-003).
steps: Sau khi cac o snapshot duoc dien san tu dong, thu sua tay gia tri 1 trong cac o (vd fee).
Luu Invoice va doc lai gia tri da luu.
checks.observation_point: Gia tri thuc te duoc luu vao Invoice sau khi admin sua tay o snapshot.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh - tai lieu chi noi 'admin chi can xac nhan roi luu', khong noi co chan sua hay khong, va neu sua thi gia tri nao duoc luu (gia tri da sua tay hay gia tri snapshot goc).

open_question_draft.summary: Sau khi cac o snapshot (payment_method_name/fee/payment_info) duoc AJAX dien san khi chuyen sang completed, admin co sua tay duoc khong, va neu sua thi gia tri nao duoc luu?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: Neu admin sua duoc va he thong luu sai gia tri (vd luu gia tri cu thay vi gia tri da sua), lich su Invoice se sai lech so voi thuc te chi tra.

checks.title: [CAN XAC NHAN] fee tren Invoice duoc tinh/luu the nao khi transfer_fee cua Payment Method de trong (Absorbed)
checks.precondition: PaymentMethod duoc chon co transfer_fee = NULL (Absorbed - Ownego chiu phi).
steps: Tao/xu ly 1 Invoice voi payment method co transfer_fee = NULL.
Doc lai gia tri fee thuc te duoc tinh/hien thi tren Invoice do (getActualFeeAttribute() hoac tuong duong).
checks.observation_point: Gia tri fee thuc te duoc tinh toan/hien thi khi PaymentMethod.transfer_fee = NULL.
checks.expected_result: KHONG CO expected_result duoc khang dinh ve gia tri cu the - KB-009 (payment-method-catalog) da xac nhan 'de trong' nghia la Ownego chiu phi, KHAC voi $0 mac dinh ve ngu nghia, nhung chua xac nhan gia tri CU THE nao duoc luu/tinh vao Invoice.fee/actual_fee trong truong hop nay.

open_question_draft.summary: fee cua invoice duoc tinh/luu the nao khi transfer_fee cua Payment Method de trong (Absorbed) - co phai $0, null, hay mot gia tri khac?
open_question_draft.why_it_matters: 'De trong' da duoc xac nhan la khac ngu nghia voi '$0' o cap Payment Method (payment-method-catalog KB-009), nhung chua co xac nhan gia tri CU THE duoc ap dung vao tinh toan actual_received/actual_fee cua Invoice trong truong hop nay - rui ro tinh sai so tien thuc nhan.

coverage_by_feature_and_risk.core_coverage: CORE/NEGATIVE(qua CHK-012)/BOUNDARY/PERMISSION/STATE_DATA/INTEGRATION/REGRESSION deu co it nhat 1 check.
coverage_by_feature_and_risk.risk_coverage: KNOWN DEFECT C2 (severity HIGH) duoc phan anh qua CHK-012 (dimension REGRESSION, oracle_strength BASELINE, priority P1) dung theo chi dan; CHK-013/014/015/016 phan anh dung cac unknown_areas xung quanh kiem soat rui ro cua defect nay.

checks_needing_confirmation.reason: Khong co kb_id xac nhan co/khong co maker-checker; day la unknown_area truc tiep lien quan known defect C2.

checks_needing_confirmation.reason: Khong co kb_id xac nhan su ton tai cua audit trail.
